ai-code-inspection.description_zh: 诊断代码缺陷、检查变更并建立 Bugfix Case。
ai-code-inspection.description_en: Diagnose defects, inspect changes and create Bugfix Cases.

planning-layer-runtime.description_zh: 交互式收集需求，维护规划、基线和开发交接。
planning-layer-runtime.description_en: Gather requirements and maintain plans, baselines and implementation handoffs.

long-task-orchestrator.description_zh: 按规划合同执行开发，保存进度和恢复检查点。
long-task-orchestrator.description_en: Implement approved contracts and preserve progress and recovery checkpoints.

testing-layer-runtime.description_zh: 组织验收、Bugfix 验证与同类问题复验。
testing-layer-runtime.description_en: Manage acceptance, Bugfix verification and similar-defect checks.
